next.reason: 1985: TERMINATE produces all control footings 'beginning with the minor control footing', then the report footing, with the prior control values available 'as though a control break has been sensed in the most major control data-name'. 2023: control items get their prior values, each control footing is printed 'beginning with the minor control footing ... as though a control break has been sensed in the most major control data item', then the report footing, then the values are restored (§2023:14.9.46.4 GR3); §2023:13.18.16.4 GR5 and §2023:13.18.57.4 GR6 (e 2, g) restate the prior-value storing and the TERMINATE printing. The no-GENERATE case is a separate rule in both editions. Same effect.
